text:
ajay singh: quick heads-up, i'm experimenting with a 'regional breaker' in policy-eval to dampen oscillation when costs spike briefly. idea: score penalty + cooldown, with a soft-defer step before full exclusion. feedback?
maria chen: overall +1. biggest risk is adding latency to policy-eval (hot path). prefer a push snapshot model; if RPC, it must be micro-latency (<1ms p50) and aggressively cached.
sylvie: push snapshots + seq_num. policy-eval should reject stale snapshots. also add a tiny inproc TTL cache keyed by region.
tom k.: watch feedback loops. breaker trips -> route shift -> new hotspots. needs smoothing/hysteresis and a grace window.
kevin b.: propose staged actions: 1) soft-defer (reduce hedging / fanout) 2) cooldown (exponential backoff) 3) hard-block (exclude region). tenant-configurable thresholds and weights.
ajay singh: implementation sketch: policy uses a ScoreVector for candidates. add `penalty = max(0, cost_score - tenant_threshold) * weight`. compute `adj = base_score - penalty`. if penalty > block_cutoff mark excluded.
maria chen: include `probe_ts` and `seq_num` in snapshots so we can gate on staleness. emit telemetry fields: `probe_value`, `probe_ts`, `tenant_bucket`, `decision_reason`.
sylvie: add a sandbox toggle `simulate_breaker=true` to log decisions without applying them. ops can run this against traces.
kevin b.: interface: primary=push snapshots (compact proto per-region), fallback=low-latency RPC for on-demand checks. snapshots sharded + versioned.
ajay singh: perf budget: extra p99 eval latency <0.5ms. unit-test penalty math and add microbench.
tom k.: rollout plan suggestion: start prod-only 5% tenants, 24h monitor, then 25%, then 100%; auto-rollback if route-churn or tail-latency worsen beyond configured deltas.
maria chen: also bucket tenants (free/dev/prod) and scale penalty weights: free=0.1, dev=0.5, prod=1.0 to avoid bricking low-tier users.
sylvie: console toggle to opt a tenant into sim-mode and dashboards: `excluded_regions_by_tenant`, `route_moves`, `probe_values`.
ajay singh: action items: sylvie add simulation toggle and logging (ETA 3d); maria add probe_ts/seq and telemetry schema (ETA 2d); kevin draft snapshot proto + RPC contract (ETA 4d); tom draft rollout playbook + rollback triggers (ETA 2d); ajay spike math + perf tests (ETA 2d).
ops-bot: checklist created: https://rwd-internal/checklists/regional-breaker-cb. assigned to @ajay @sylvie @maria
maria chen: please simulate with historical traces in the sim-harness to find degenerate cases (tiny tenants causing large route moves).
kevin b.: also add a short soft-defer period before hard-block so we can observe effects without full exclusion.
ajay singh: will open RFC PR with design, telemetry dashboards, and perf budget. landing behind feature-flag initially. i'll ping #eng when PR is up. :thumbsup:
